title: Wynn Scoops 16 Accolades at "China's Wine List of the Year Awards" Reaffirming its Excellence in Gastronomy and Wine
summary: Chef Tam's Seasons clinches five awards, Mizumi retains
body_markdown:
*Chef Tam's Seasons clinches five awards, Mizumi retains "China's Best Sake List" honor, and eight Wynn signature restaurants earn the highest distinction of "3 Glasses"*


**Macao, October 29, 2026** — Wynn reaffirmed its position at the forefront of fine dining and wine excellence at the 14th "China's Wine List of the Year Awards", securing 16 accolades across its restaurants and wine teams. Eight participating Wynn signature restaurants earned the highest distinction of "3 Glasses", while Chef Tam's Seasons, the two-MICHELIN-starred Cantonese restaurant at Wynn Palace, scooped five awards. Mizumi, the one-MICHELIN-starred Japanese restaurant at Wynn Palace, retained its "China's Best Sake List" honor for the second consecutive year, while two members of Wynn's F&B team received individual honors for their professional excellence.


These achievements underscore Wynn's strengths in fine dining, sommelier expertise and wine pairing, reflecting its unwavering commitment toward delivering world-class gastronomic experiences. The awards also reaffirm Wynn's dedication to celebrating Macao's distinctive culinary heritage and elevating its profile as a UNESCO Creative City of Gastronomy.


**A clean sweep: All eight Wynn signature restaurants earn top ratings**
Chef Tam's Seasons, the two-MICHELIN-starred Cantonese restaurant at Wynn Palace, was a standout at this year's awards, scooping five distinct honors: " **China's Wine List of the Year 2026** – **Hong Kong, Macau & Taiwan** "; " **Best Wine List** – **Macau SAR** "; " **China's Best Hotel Restaurant Wine List** "; " **China's Best Chinese Restaurant Wine List** "; **and** " **China's Best Listing of Chinese Spirits** ". Spanning wine, Chinese spirits, and diverse dining settings, these accolades reflect the restaurant's innovative approach and exceptional expertise in wine-list curation and the development of a comprehensive beverage selection.


**Mizumi** , the MICHELIN-starred Japanese restaurant at Wynn Palace, retained its title of " **China's Best Sake List** " for the second consecutive year. Its extensive sake collection features exclusive award-winning selections from some of Japan's most prestigious breweries, alongside seasonal offerings and limited-edition releases. This continued recognition further highlights Wynn's expertise in curating exceptional beverage selections to complement distinctive dining experiences.


On top of these accolades, eight of Wynn's signature restaurants now hold the highest distinction of "3 Glasses". **Chef Tam's Seasons, Lakeview Palace, Mizumi, SW Steakhouse** and Sole e **Mare at Fontana** at Wynn Palace, as well as **Drunken Fish** at Wynn Macau retained their "3 Glasses" distinction, while **Sushi Mizumi** at Wynn Palace and **Wing Lei** at Wynn Macau advanced from "2 Glasses" last year to "3 Glasses" this year.


**Talent in the spotlight: Wynn's F&B leadership and sommelier services celebrated**
J **ust Wong, Executive Director of Beverage Operations for Wynn Macau and Wynn Palace,** received **"China's Outstanding F&B Director/Manager/Owner of the Year 2026 – Hong Kong, Macau, Taiwan"** accolade. This recognition reflects his passion for wine and sake culture, his professional vision, and his sustained efforts to advance and innovate Wynn's wine and beverage programs over the years. T **roy Jiang, Sommelier at Chef Tam's Seasons,** earned **"China's 'Outstanding Sommelier' of the Year 2026 – Hong Kong, Macau, Taiwan"** accolade in recognition of his professional excellence in sommelier services. These accolades affirm Wynn's depth of expertise in both F&B operations management and professional sommelier services. From wine-list curation and beverage selection to the refinement of dining settings and the enhancement of guest experiences, every aspect is underpinned by the expertise and dedication of top-tier teams working both front-of-house and behind the scenes.


**From competition to the table: championing Chinese wine from Macao**


Behind these award-winning restaurants and teams lies Wynn's strategic vision and long-term commitment to advancing fine dining and guest experiences. The Wynn Signature Chinese Wine Awards is one of Wynn's leading visionary initiatives. Established in 2024 by "Wynn Signature" – the exclusive lifestyle brand at Wynn – this awards platform has rapidly evolved into a world-class platform encompassing wine education, industry exchange, judging and promotional events.


In 2025, the competition introduced the "Wynn Sommelier's Choice" award category. Through this initiative, Wynn's sommelier team draws on its expertise in food and wine pairing, along with its meticulous approach to wine selection, to identify Chinese wines that best complement and enhance the distinctive characteristics of the dishes served at each restaurant. A selection of award-winning wines from the competition is also incorporated into the wine lists at Wynn's restaurants and featured across a diverse range of dining experiences, including pairing menus, regional wine dinners, and themed tastings, creating opportunities for Chinese wines to demonstrate their versatility across cuisines, cultures and dining occasions.


The schedule and promotional roadmap for the 2027 edition of the Wynn Signature Chinese Wine Awards have recently been announced. By leveraging this competition platform and drawing on its portfolio of acclaimed dining establishments and professional sommelier teams, Wynn will continue introducing exceptional Chinese wines to guests from around the world, showcasing the distinctive allure of China's terroirs while further strengthening Macao's unique appeal as a world-class gastronomic tourism destination.


Established in 1993 by Tucker Seabrook, the Wine List of the Year Awards were introduced to recognize and reward the enormous investment in time, skill and resources that go into developing the best quality wine and beverage lists. In 2012, Rob Hirst, founder of the International Wine List of the Year Awards, and Tommy Lam, founder of the China National Sommelier Competition, launched "China's Wine List of the Year Awards" in China. Since its establishment more than 10 years ago, the awards have not only discovered and recognized many outstanding restaurants and individuals, but have also risen to become the authoritative list of the leading players in China's F&B sector and sommelier industry.
